chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd and Safwan from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to offer the Qurbani sacrifice with a horned male ram, black in color, which looked black and walked black.
ai.seo_question: What were the specific physical characteristics of the animal Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) sacrificed for Eid al-Adha?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (SAW) preference for a specific aesthetic in sacrificial animals, describing a horned, entirely black male ram. In Shia jurisprudence, this detail underscores the emphasis on selecting pristine, unblemished livestock for Udhiyah, reflecting the reverence due to the ritual. The specific mention of 'black in appearance and movement' suggests a holistic view of the animal's physical integrity and vitality.
